crawl: Chrome live crawl, same-origin fetch, cache: no-store, sequential per URL, ~06:55-07:15 Vietnam time on 2026-09-29 (one-day step from 28 Sep)
method: TTFB measured with performance.now() around a sequential fetch of each URL with a 15 s abort. Words counted on a body clone with script/style/noscript/template removed. Schema blocks counted as application/ld+json elements, @type walked through @graph. Internal links are unique same-origin paths per page.
score_rationale: Health RISES 94 → 95 (raw 94.25 → 95.40) on the single largest structural fix of the series. CRAWLABILITY 95 → 98: THE /articles OVERLAY IS GONE after 32 days. A live load of the hub, waited out 16 seconds, now returns zero elements at z-index ≥ 9999, zero fixed elements covering 80 pct or more of the viewport, and four probe points across the viewport that all resolve to ordinary static content instead of a blocking div; 109 article links are directly clickable in the DOM. This was named in every previous run as the main cap on this sub-score, so removing it is worth three points. It is not a full recovery to 100 because the site-wide promoted link the template dropped on 28 Sep has NOT returned: total distinct internal links moved only 2,708 → 2,711, and the three added links come from three individual articles, not from the template. Orphans stay 0 for an eighteenth crawl, hub-only articles 0, linked-but-absent-from-sitemap 0. PERFORMANCE 98 → 99: the ceiling fell again 617 → 581 ms, site mean 334 → 323 ms and the core group improved sharply 402 → 336 ms as the homepage came down 617 → 477 ms and is no longer the slowest page on the site. All 118 pages under one second for a sixth consecutive crawl, nothing in the 1-3 s band, nothing over 3 s. STRUCTURED DATA holds at 92: FAQPage coverage unchanged at 82 of 95 articles (86.3 pct), 116 of 118 pages carry schema and the total JSON-LD block count is unchanged at 394; the same 13 articles are still missing a FAQPage block. ON-PAGE holds at 92: h1, title, canonical, self-canonical and meta-description coverage are all 118/118, heading-level skips stay at 0, and the alt-text gap is byte-identical at 1,269 of 1,387 images (91.5 pct). CONTENT 92 → 93: the corpus grew for the first time in this series without a new article, 239,577 → 241,329 words (+1,752) across exactly five articles, and the three shortest of them were lifted clear of the 1,500-word mark.

pages.note: 117 sitemap HTML pages plus /login. All 118 returned 200. No new page and no removed page against 28 Sep; the page set is identical for a nineteenth crawl.

sitemap.linked_absent_method: Re-measured this run from the inbound-link graph over all 118 crawled pages, counting only same-origin HTML paths.
sitemap.legacy_recheck_note: All ten legacy long-slug URLs re-fetched today under /articles/: ten 200s, ten self-canonical, none in the sitemap and none linked from any crawled page. Thirteenth consecutive confirmation.

ttfb_ms.note: THE CEILING FELL AGAIN 617 → 581 ms and the homepage is NO LONGER the slowest page: it came down 617 → 477 ms and the slowest page is now /articles/home-cinema-cost-australia at 581 ms. Core improved sharply 402 → 336 ms, articles 327 → 325 ms, projects 254 → 255 ms. Site mean 334 → 323 ms; median edged 268 → 270 ms. All 118 pages under one second for a sixth consecutive crawl; nothing in the 1-3 s band and nothing over 3 s. Cache-busted re-reads: / 499/398/449/325 ms, /studio 333/313/532/316 ms, /articles 540/323/324/306 ms - all tighter than the 28 Sep spread. Navigation timing: / TTFB 624 ms, DOMContentLoaded 862 ms, load 2,317 ms; /articles TTFB 846 ms, DOMContentLoaded 1,385 ms, load 3,544 ms.

content.note: THE CORPUS GREW FOR THE FIRST TIME WITHOUT A NEW ARTICLE: 239,577 → 241,329 words (+1,752) with the article count unchanged at 95 and no page added or removed. Exactly five articles changed, and the three that moved most were the three shortest on the site: contemporary-houses-a-practical-guide 1,384 → 1,920, virtual-reality-in-australia-home-design 1,393 → 1,838 and how-3d-configurators-increase-buyer-commitment 1,062 → 1,504 - all three now clear of 1,500 words. Average per article 2,417 → 2,436. The 13 thin pages are unchanged: they are all core and project templates plus /login and /start-interactive, not articles.

schema.note: Byte-identical to 28 Sep on every structured-data signal: 116 of 118 pages carry schema, 394 JSON-LD blocks in total, FAQPage on 82 of 95 articles (86.3 pct) plus /faq for 83 overall, and the same 13 articles are still missing a FAQPage block. Only /start-interactive and /login carry none. Type mix unchanged: BreadcrumbList 114, Article 95, BlogPosting 95, FAQPage 83, WebPage 11, Organization 7, WebSite 7, CreativeWork 6, Service 5.

heading_skips.note: No heading level is skipped anywhere on the site.

onpage.note: Byte-identical to 28 Sep on every on-page signal: 118/118 for exactly one h1, title, meta description, canonical and self-canonical; zero heading-level skips; meta descriptions run 83-189 characters, all inside the useful range. The alt-text gap is unchanged at 118 of 1,387 images (1,269 with alt, 91.5 pct) and is still one template image repeated once per page - a single template fix clears all 118. 96 of 118 pages still render a heading before the h1.

crawlability.note: THE HEADLINE IS A FIX, NOT A REGRESSION: THE /articles OVERLAY IS GONE after 32 days. A live load of the hub, waited out 16 seconds, returns zero elements at z-index ≥ 9999 anywhere in the document, zero fixed elements covering 80 pct or more of the viewport, and elementFromPoint at four separate probe points - centre, upper, lower and left - all resolve to ordinary static content rather than a blocking div. 109 article links are directly clickable in the DOM. Every previous run named this as the single largest crawlability defect and the main cap on the sub-score. THE 28 SEP TEMPLATE REGRESSION HAS NOT REVERSED: the site-wide promoted link is still missing and total distinct internal links moved only 2,708 → 2,711. The three added links come from three individual articles that also gained content - contemporary-houses-a-practical-guide, how-3d-configurators-increase-buyer-commitment and virtual-reality-in-australia-home-design - not from the template, so the featured block still promotes three articles rather than four. The hub still links all 95 articles from a single server response, so orphans are zero for an eighteenth crawl and hub-only articles stay at zero.

tag_check.note: Homepage DOM tag check: window.google_tag_manager exposes 17 keys including the GTM container GTM-PZ9N8QTR, the Google Ads tag AW-18039433307 and the GA4 tag G-43HE633LGK. dataLayer length 3. window.gtag is undefined, as it has been on every previous check - GTM loads the tags itself.

roadmap: DONE - the /articles overlay is REMOVED after 32 days. Zero elements at z-index >= 9999, zero full-viewport fixed elements, all four viewport probe points resolve to ordinary content and 109 article links are clickable. This was the P0 on every previous run.

P0 - restore the site-wide promoted link the article template dropped on 28 Sep. Total internal links are still 2,708 -> 2,711 against 2,802 before the regression; the featured block promotes three articles where it used to promote four.
P1 - batch a FAQPage block into the 13 articles still missing one; coverage has been frozen at 82 of 95 (86.3 pct) for three crawls and the method is proven.
P2 - lift the six project pages off roughly 178 words each; with the three shortest articles now fixed, these are unambiguously the thinnest real content on the site.
P2 - the homepage is fixed: 617 -> 477 ms and no longer the slowest page. The new ceiling is /articles/home-cinema-cost-australia at 581 ms, which is a content page, not a template problem.
P3 - add alt text to the template image: one template fix clears all 118 missing-alt instances.
P3 - decide whether the ten legacy long-slug URLs should be added to the sitemap or 301-redirected; they resolve 200 and self-canonical under /articles/ but are unlinked and unlisted.
Hold - keep adding sibling-article links on new posts so hub-only articles stay at zero.
process_note: One crawl served both this audit and the SEO report in the same run, so TTFB, word counts, schema counts and the internal-link graph agree between the two reports by construction.
